tool: autocannon (via npx, k6 not installed on this machine)

journeys.note: fr.task.list — the caller's full task list (~4.1k rows seeded). The resolver paginates nothing; the "paginated" brief item is exercised as the heaviest list read the API actually exposes.
upcomingOccurrences on a live every-weekday rule — materialisation + live previewDates computation.
collaborators on a task holding pending+revoked+accepted invitations — the share read path behind every fan-out.
notificationPreferences read — the digest path itself is write-side (digest windows flush on delivery); this is the heaviest notify read the schema exposes.
exportMyData — decrypts every audit line naming the caller (468 seeded). The heaviest single read.

draftSLOs.note: Draft only — measured, not enforced. Keys are p97_5 because that is the nearest percentile autocannon emits; treat as the p95 line.

taskList.note: full unbounded list; revisit if pagination lands

auditExport.note: decrypts every line; scales with log size
